open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have app {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} (h : a.Subset b) (h' : c.Subset d) :
      (a ++ c).Subset (b ++ d) :=
    List.append_subset.mpr ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h,
      List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ h'⟩
  intro h
  induction h <;> try first
    | exact List.nil_subset _
    | assumption
    | exact app ‹_› ‹_›
    | exact app (app ‹_› ‹_›) ‹_›
  case app fn e m hfn he hwf ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact fun _ h => h
    · next hfalse =>
      cases hwf IsOldPred.oldPred
      exfalso
      apply hfalse
      rfl
    · exact app ihfn ihe
